name: Trial of the Hollow
theme: A mossy, softly glowing cave beneath the forest where the player wakes: roots, ferns, glowing crystals and fireflies, ending at a dried-up ancient wellspring.
story: The amnesiac player's first trial. Teaches battles, deck challenges, healing, and a boss. Clearing it lets the spring recognize the player and opens the road to town.
boss: The Hollow Warden (a hulking moss-and-stone guardian)
buffs: Gentle: base 10 HP; the node before the boss fully heals.
reward_first: Choose 1 of 3 cards from your chosen Path after each battle (3 total); opens the road to town.
hook: Starts automatically after choosing your element (or skipped via the secret tunnel).

name: The House of Gains
theme: A towering fortress-gym: marble columns wrapped in chains, propaganda banners of the regime, rubber-mat floors, giant dumbbell statues; beneath it, the bare stone Iron-less Prison with no equipment at all.
story: The regime that overthrew the Beefcake leader rules from here. Deep below lies the Iron-less Prison where the original leader is held. Rescue him (optional branch) and he joins you; at the top, Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent waits. In the final confrontation the frail-looking leader throws off his robes to reveal he is still incredibly muscular: true strength comes from the heart and the mind.
buffs: Pump Iron: your Beefcake units enter with +1 attack. Iron-less Prison (nodes 8-9): Iron can't be used.
reward_first: The Big Unit (B-32), a Gilded Beefcake Pack, bonus gold and XP; frees the Gainlands.
hook: Swole Station rumor: "The old champion isn't dead. He's under the House."

name: The Test Kitchen
theme: An experimental kitchen, food laboratory and ridiculous weapons-development center: gleaming steel counters, bubbling beakers of sauce, conveyor belts, blueprints, and enormous unfinished food-powered war machines.
story: What looks like a thriving culinary R&D center is secretly a military-industrial complex. The doppelganger posing as the Gourmand leader uses corrupted food to bend the chefs into building war machines for the big bad. Clues along the way (the R&D Archives) reveal the impostor before the final fight.
boss: The Doppelganger (posing as Grand Chef Escoffina)
buffs: Experimental: at the start of each battle, a random unit on each side gains a random keyword. Corrupted Food: healing effects heal 1 less.
reward_first: Grand Chef Escoffina (G-33), a Gilded Gourmand Pack, bonus gold and XP; frees the Endless Buffet.
hook: A nervous line cook in the Grand Pantry: "Chef doesn't taste her own sauces anymore. Chef ALWAYS tastes."

name: The Hall of Final Approvals
theme: The ultimate bureaucratic nightmare: an endless gray-green government complex of marble halls, filing-cabinet canyons, ticket kiosks, waiting rooms, rubber stamps, and floating ghostly paperwork.
story: Authority over the Necrocrats was transferred to the big bad through perfectly valid paperwork, so the Necrocrats dutifully enforce absurd oppression. Navigate departments, waiting rooms, and regulations to reach the official who now holds that authority and get the paperwork reversed (by force).
boss: Undersecretary Vellum, Acting Director of Final Approvals
buffs: Processing Time: each player's first spell each turn costs 1 more. Red Tape Everywhere: start each battle with one Red Tape.
reward_first: Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No (N-33), a Gilded Necrocrat Pack, bonus gold and XP; frees the D.N.A.
hook: A ghost in the D.N.A. lobby holding a stack of denied appeals: "I just want to finish dying properly."

nodes.name: Form 27-B Office
nodes.note: fill out forms: boon or curse

nodes.name: The Shredding Room
nodes.note: shred a card for a reward

name: The Rotheart
theme: The Verdant Dump's vibrant junkyard-farm turned unnaturally alive and twisted: choking vines, mutated glowing fungi, invasive roots splitting machinery, sickly purple-green light, pulsing roots leading to a giant corrupted heart-tree.
story: The Refusemancer leader was corrupted through her own connection to nature, and the corruption spreads through the ecosystem. The deeper you go, the more warped the land becomes. At the Rotheart, the corrupted core, you face Compostella and sever the big bad's influence over the natural world. Severing the Heart Roots first weakens her.
boss: Compostella, the Rotheart (the corrupted Refusemancer leader)
buffs: Overgrowth: at the start of each turn, each unit gets a buff. Rot: at end of turn, units with 1 defense are destroyed.
reward_first: Archdruid Compostella (R-33, cured), a Gilded Refusemancer Pack, bonus gold and XP; frees the Verdant Dump.
hook: Druids at the Compost Grange: "The Archdruid hasn't spoken in weeks. The compost... it's growing teeth."

nodes.name: The Heart Roots
nodes.note: sever the tendrils; weakens the boss

name: Primm's Castle
theme: A gleaming, perfectly symmetrical palace of white stone, gold trim, and mirrors everywhere, every surface reflecting Primm, while cracks, rifts, and corruption seep through behind the polish.
story: The heart of Primm's rule. His Perfection believes he is improving the kingdom, but everything here reflects only him. Side wings show how he 'perfected' each faction; the Archive of Good Intentions reveals the tragedy of a man who meant well and became a tyrant. The final chamber is the Model Room, a giant scale model of the kingdom he rearranges by hand.
buffs: The Capital's broken-services debuffs (one per faction whose zone isn't freed yet). Perfect Order: units can't have more than 2 keywords. Mirrors: the first card each player plays each game is copied for the opponent.
reward_first: Reunion of the Paths (P4-02), bonus gold and XP, the ending, and the postgame unlock (all Paths can be combined).
hook: The resistance hideout: "It ends where it began. The castle."

nodes.name: Gourmand Wing: the Doppelganger's Lab Notes
Refusemancer Wing: the Corrupted Seed Vault

name: The Ascent of Mount Swolympus
theme: A sunny, impossibly steep mountain climb with switchback trails, chalk-dusted ledges, ancient stone weights, and clouds below; a glowing altar at the summit.
story: Legend says the Barbell of the Ancients rests atop Mount Swolympus and can only be lifted by the worthy. Climb past rival lifters to the summit and prove yourself to its ancient guardian.
boss: The Ancient Spotter (a stone colossus who has been spotting the barbell for 1,000 years)
buffs: Thin Air: units with Hustle get +1/+0.
reward_repeat: Small gold and a Beefcake Path Pack.
hook: A wheezing old hermit at the Swole Station: "Only the worthy reach the top. Also bring water."

name: Omakase
theme: A tiny, secret, impossibly exclusive sushi restaurant: hinoki-wood counter, paper lanterns, a koi pond, and conveyor belts that go much deeper than they should.
story: There is no menu. You leave your fate to the chef. Survive three courses served by increasingly intense sushi chefs, ending with the Chef's Choice: a legendary bull made of toro.
reward_repeat: Small gold and a Gourmand Path Pack.
hook: A golden reservation card hidden in the Endless Buffet: "Seating: 1. Courses: 3. Survival: optional."

name: The Waiting Room of Eternity
theme: An infinite gray waiting room: endless rows of chairs, flickering number displays, potted plants that died centuries ago, and a single desk at the far end.
story: To get your form stamped you must reach the front of the line. The line is eternal. Fight your way past the receptionist, the queue, and finally Betty Bones herself, who is very sorry, but you'll need forms A through F.
buffs: Please Wait: units enter exhausted (both players).
reward_repeat: Small gold and a Necrocrat Path Pack.
hook: A ghost clutching a crumpled ticket: "Number 4,000,212? They're on 3. Can you help?"

name: The Trash Panda Throne
theme: A secret raccoon kingdom built under a giant dumpster: bottle-cap banners, pizza-box walls, soda-can towers, and a throne made of trash-can lids.
story: The raccoons have a king, and he has a lot to answer for (and is sweating about it). Fight through the alley guards and the pizza crust court to the Throne of Lids.
buffs: Midnight Snack: whenever a player eats garbage, they gain 1 HP.
reward_repeat: Small gold and a Refusemancer Path Pack.
hook: A furious druid at the Compost Grange: "Someone has been eating ALL the compost. Little paw prints. A tiny crown."

name: The Old Service Tunnels
theme: Forgotten underground tunnels the four factions once built together: brick arches, rusty pipes, faded four-faction murals, and Primm's enforcers patrolling with lanterns.
story: These tunnels connected the four factions' services back when they cooperated. Primm sealed and forgot them. Clearing them proves the old harmony still exists underneath his perfect city, and opens a secret way into the Capital.
buffs: Forgotten Harmony: multi-path cards cost 1 less.
reward_repeat: Small gold and a General Pack.
hook: A resistance scout: "There's an older way into the city. Nobody remembers it. That's the point."

name: The Forgotten Vault
theme: An ancient vault beneath the main town from the Old Kingdom: mossy stone halls, four faded faction banners, clockwork guardians, and a glowing four-colored core.
story: Beneath the town lies a vault from the days when the four Paths marched as one. Its clockwork guardians still keep watch, waiting for someone worthy of the Old Kingdom's banner.
reward_repeat: Small gold and a General Pack.
hook: An elder in the main town: "There's a door under the old well that's been locked since before I was born."
